upgradeRule: each relation and constraint change receives a new circuitId and additive registry entry

circuits.name: sanctions-clear
circuits.predicate: issuer-authenticated credential status slot is allocated and active under the governed packed-status root

circuits.name: age-threshold
circuits.predicate: normalized private date of birth satisfies a policy-bound minimum age at a policy-bound date

circuits.name: nationality-set-membership
circuits.predicate: normalized private nationality is a member of the policy-bound canonical country set

circuits.name: expiry-valid
circuits.predicate: normalized private expiry date is on or after a policy-bound date

circuits.name: assurance-minimum
circuits.predicate: private assurance class meets the policy-bound minimum
